description:
Sample the voltage of 1 to 4 board pins (the board's own numbers: Nano A0-A7 = 14-21, Uno A0-A5 = 14-19, Mega
    A0-A15 = 54-69; by default the setup's scope probes) at
    rate_hz (100 to 10 000) for duration_ms (1 to 10 000 simulated ms), 200 000 samples at most in all. An ADC input
    reads the voltage the circuit applies; any other pin, its logic level times the supply (PWM shows as a square wave).
    Simulation only: refused during a turn on a real bench, whose analyser has no analog channel. Read the result with
    read_capture.
name: capture_analog
title: Capture analog signals
